title: J&K Congress stages protest against BJP over Kishtwar incident

ai.summary: The J&K Congress staged a protest against the BJP over the Kishtwar incident, following J&K's loss of statehood in 2019 when it was split into two union territories.

facts.claim: The J&K Congress staged a protest against the BJP over the Kishtwar incident
facts.quote: J&K Congress stages protest against BJP over Kishtwar incident

ai.background_note: J&K lost statehood in 2019, when it was split into two union territories. The elected government and the Congress say the Centre has not kept its promise to restore it, and protested in July 2026.
